findings.evidence: The declarations are at lines 45, 51, 57, 63, 68, and 72; their only uses are in `inv_mul_one_zero_eq_zero` (line 79) and `inv_mul_zero_zero_eq_one` (line 88). Each proof is just `SL2_inv_expl` or `coe_mul`/`mul_apply`/`Fin.sum_univ_two` followed by `rfl` or `simp`.
findings.fix: Keep the focused `inv_mul_*` helpers, but prove them directly using `SL2_inv_expl`, `coe_mul`, `Matrix.mul_apply`, and `Fin.sum_univ_two`; delete the six projection wrappers.
findings.issue: `inv_apply_one_zero`, `inv_apply_one_one`, `inv_apply_zero_zero`, `inv_apply_zero_one`, `mul_apply_one_zero`, and `mul_apply_zero_zero` merely restate Mathlib lemmas at fixed coordinates and are each used once.

summary: Six single-use private coordinate lemmas duplicate direct specializations of existing Mathlib API; the higher-level factoring can remain without this redundant layer.
